description: Sector overlay for accounting firms, audit practices, assurance providers, financial reporting professionals, and related professional-services documentation in Nigeria.

metadata.scope: Nigeria-only sector overlay controls for Accounting. Intended to be used with core_control_library.
metadata.source_note: Source basis reviewed against official Nigerian statutes, regulations, regulator rules, codes, directives and standards current to 2026-08-30. This deterministic screening pack requires qualified human review before legal or regulatory reliance.
metadata.external_knowledge_policy: No external knowledge is introduced during document evaluation. Regulatory source mappings live only in this versioned rule pack.

primary_sources.name: Financial Reporting Council of Nigeria Act, 2011 as amended by the Financial Reporting Council of Nigeria (Amendment) Act, 2023
primary_sources.issuer: Federal Republic of Nigeria / Financial Reporting Council of Nigeria

primary_sources.name: FRC audit-related Rules 9-14, including Rule 14 on NOCLAR (2025), and the 2025 enforcement notice
Money Laundering (Prevention and Prohibition) Act, 2022 and EFCC AML/CFT/CPF Regulations for DNFBPs, 2024 where applicable
primary_sources.issuer: Federal Republic of Nigeria / SCUML / EFCC
